# Onuri: Notes & Life Tracker

> Onuri is a clean, private-first iOS application that acts as an automatic second brain and life tracker, connecting people, places, dates, and ideas effortlessly as you type.

## Core Links
- App Store: [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6796028277)
- Official Website: [Onuri Landing Page](https://onuri.app)
- Privacy Policy: [Privacy Policy](https://onuri.app/privacy.html)
- Terms of Service: [Terms of Service](https://onuri.app/terms.html)
- Community: [Reddit Launch Discussion](https://www.reddit.com/r/SideProject/comments/1vqqpvs/i_built_a_notes_app_where_your_words_connect/)

## Overview
Onuri provides an intuitive mobile interface for personal journaling, daily note-taking, and life tracking without compromising user privacy. Built natively for iOS using Apple Natural Language frameworks and StoreKit, Onuri replaces rigid folder structures and manual wiki-style linking with automatic entity connection.

## Key Features
- **Automatic Connections:** Automatically detects and links people, places, dates, times, and topics as you write.
- **Fast Entity Search:** Instantly filter and rediscover entries through connected topics, locations, or people rather than manual tags.
- **Private-First Architecture:** App Store label is "Data Not Collected." Zero ads, zero tracking, zero third-party analytics.
- **iCloud Sync & Export:** Syncs natively through the user's personal iCloud account with full TXT and CSV export options.
- **Multilingual Support:** Fully localized in English, Japanese, and Korean.

## Technical Details & Pricing
- **Platform:** iOS 17.6 or later (iPhone)
- **Pricing:** Free tier includes unlimited notes and core auto-linking; optional Premium tier (€2.99) unlocks deeper relationship and theme insights.
- **Developer:** Built independently in Dublin, Ireland.
